newsitem.title: USA: Registry to buy Application Resources.
newsitem.headline: Registry to buy Application Resources.

text.p: Registry Inc. said Wednesday it will acquire Application Resources Inc., another provider of information technology services, in a stock deal worth about $79.3 million.
Under the definitive agreement, Registry will issue about 1.7 million new common shares for the privately held company based in San Francisco.
Registry's stock was unchanged at $46.625 early on Nasdaq.
The deal is expected to close by Nov. 27.
Registry, based in Newton, Mass., provides network systems consulting and documentation services.
The acquisition will raise the number of Registry branch offices to 29 and the number of its information technology consultants to 2,200 nationwide.
